import zipfile, os, textwrap
z='fuzzing/corpora/broker_fuzz_test_config_seed_corpus.zip'
out='/tmp/mosq_seeds'
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(z) as zz:
    for n in zz.namelist()[:5]:
        p=os.path.join(out,n)
        open(p,'wb').write(zz.read(n))
        print('---',n,'---')
        print(open(p,'rb').read().decode('utf-8','replace'))
